_about: The one placeholder set for tests and docs (docs/design/generic-repository.md section 3.1). scripts/guards/deployment_values.py allowlists exactly these values; tests/placeholders.py reads this file. `allowlist` holds what the shape rules let through that is not a placeholder: reserved names and public product hosts.

allowlist._rulings: The owner's rulings of 2026-11-07 (part of #2688): the entries below are public or generic, not deployment values. Each carries its reason in `why`. Nothing on the private pattern list may be added here; a tenant slug that a list entry matches is reported regardless (deployment_values.py, Allow.screened).
